name: SikaSwell® P Profiles
summary: SikaSwell®-Profiles are rubber, sealing profiles which swell they come into contact with water.
metaDescription: SikaSwell®-Profiles are rubber, sealing profiles which swell they come into contact with water.
usage: - Pipe and steel work penetrations through walls and floor slabs
- Construction joints in cable ducts, etc.
- Around all types of penetrations through concrete
advantages: - Can be applied on different substrates
- With protective coating to avoid premature swelling
- Adaptable to fit many different detailing tasks

rel.t: Polyacrylic elastic injection resin for permanent watertight sealing
rel.s: Sika® Injection-306 is a very low viscous, elastic polyacrylic injection resin with a versatile and adjustable reaction time which can be used in ground water protection zones.
a: Provides a passivating environment for embedded steel reinforcement
Adjustable curing time between 10 and 60 minutes
Permanently elastic, can absorb limited movement
Capable of reversibly absorbing (swelling) and releasing (shrinking) moisture
Very low viscosity comparable to water
